component.name: influxdb
component.title: InfluxDB
component.description: Write points to and run queries on InfluxDB v1, a time series database.
component.label: database

influxDB.description: The org.influxdb.InfluxDB client that all endpoints of the component use. When it is set or autowired, the endpoints do not look up the bean named in their URI path.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

camelInfluxDB.RetentionPolicy.description: The name of the retention policy to write a single point to. It replaces the retentionPolicy option; an empty value is ignored. It is not used for a BatchPoints body.

camelInfluxDB.databaseName.description: The name of the database to write a single point to or to run the query on. It replaces the databaseName option; an empty value is ignored. It is not used for a BatchPoints body.

camelInfluxDB.query.description: The InfluxQL query that the query operation runs. It replaces the query option; an empty value is ignored.

producerIn.description: The org.influxdb.dto.Point to write, or a Map of the field names and their values with the measurement name under the camelInfluxDB.MeasurementName key. Text, bytes or a List of Points fail: line protocol is not parsed. With batch=true the body must be a BatchPoints. The query and ping operations do not read the body: the query comes from the camelInfluxDB.query header or the query option

producerOut.description: An insert leaves the body unchanged. A query gives the QueryResult of InfluxDB; an error the server reports in it (such as an unknown database) fails the exchange instead. Ping gives the Pong with the version of the server

connectionBean.description: The name of the org.influxdb.InfluxDB client bean in the registry that the endpoint uses. The bean is not looked up when the influxDB component option is set or autowired: that client is used instead.

autoCreateDatabase.description: Whether to create the database of the databaseName option when the endpoint starts and the database does not exist. It is used only when checkDatabaseExistence is true.

batch.description: Whether the insert operation writes an org.influxdb.dto.BatchPoints body in one request, instead of a single org.influxdb.dto.Point. The database and the retention policy of the BatchPoints are used, not the databaseName and retentionPolicy options or their headers.

checkDatabaseExistence.description: Whether to run SHOW DATABASES when the endpoint starts, to check that the database of the databaseName option exists. It has an effect only together with autoCreateDatabase: on its own a missing database is neither reported nor created.

databaseName.description: The name of the database that the producer writes points to and runs queries on. The camelInfluxDB.databaseName header replaces this option. If neither is set, the database set on the InfluxDB client is used. A BatchPoints body carries its own database.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: insert writes the body to InfluxDB, query runs the query and gives its QueryResult as the body, and ping gives the Pong of the server as the body. The value is not case-sensitive, and another value fails the start of the endpoint.

query.description: The InfluxQL query that the query operation runs. The camelInfluxDB.query header replaces this option, and the query operation fails if neither is set.

retentionPolicy.description: The name of the retention policy that the producer writes a single point to. InfluxDB takes the value as the name of a policy of the database, so the default works only on a database with a policy named default (InfluxDB 1.0 and later name the policy they create autogen). The camelInfluxDB.RetentionPolicy header replaces this option. A BatchPoints body carries its own retention policy.

lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
